param_seed: "{name}": a positive whole number is expected.
class_missing: This ComfyUI lacks the recipe's "{node}" node.
class_custom: "{node}" is not a ComfyUI node here (an added node or an online service): the recipe is not replayed on it.
class_different: The "{node}" node here differs from the definition the recipe expects.
signature_unknown_key: Recipe catalogue signed by an unknown key.
unsigned_public: The recipe "{id}" is not signed by the author: it only serves on this PC and on your machines, never for the public network.
download_unpinned: "{name}" has no declared fingerprint yet: AIODOS does not download it.
download_no_comfyui: ComfyUI is not installed on this PC: there is no folder to put this model in.
download_busy: Another ComfyUI model is already downloading.
download_mismatch: {file}: the received file does not match its fingerprint. Nothing is kept.
